value.rationale: Second-order permutation marginals are a natural fixed-budget summary for distributions on permutations, and 231-avoiding permutations form the canonical Catalan stack-sortable class. The exact six-position failure is not forced by feature count (382 feasible feature functions versus 132 states); its nullity is exactly twenty. Only twelve dimensions come from all elementary three-swap cubes, leaving a quantitatively nontrivial residual. The result provides the sharp complete-recovery threshold and explicit indistinguishable four-atom measures without claiming an all-order rank formula.
